short_summary: A presentation introducing HealthRate, a SaaS platform for pricing high-cost healthcare claims, describing its solution, business model, target customers, competitive advantages, and featuring CEO Tim Michaels and Chief Actuary Emeritus Paul Stordahl.
long_summary: HealthRate is an award‑winning SaaS platform that provides payers with the best pricing for high‑cost claims without impacting quality, causing provider abrasion, or requiring patient intervention. The solution is audit‑friendly and can be implemented via a simple click‑button analysis. Pricing is offered either as a percentage of savings or a monthly flat‑fee model. Target customers include Payers, At‑Risk Providers, Employers, Stop‑Loss Providers, Reinsurance firms, and third‑party service providers. Competitive advantage stems from decades of domain experience, trillions of data points, advanced statistical methods, and recent AI/ML advancements. The deck also highlights the leadership of Tim Michaels (CEO) and Paul Stordahl (Chief Actuary Emeritus, UnitedHealthcare).
